title: Anthropic just raised 10 billion and here is their plan

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Anthropic just secured $10 billion — the biggest AI funding round ever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This could change the future of AI safety and innovation forever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They're building a new kind of AI that’s both powerful and aligned with human values.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Their latest model, Claude 3, can reason across multiple domains with unprecedented clarity.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects everyone from developers to businesses relying on AI tools.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway: Anthropic is betting big on safe, scalable AI for the real world.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What do you think — is this the future of AI or a risky gamble?
